assertions.title: CLI entry point and help text

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack --help` with isolated MLX_STACK_HOME
steps.expected: Usage output lists documented commands and exits 0

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack --version` and compare with `pyproject.toml` version
steps.expected: Printed version matches project version and exits 0
steps.observed: Output was `mlx-stack, version 0.1.0`; pyproject version is `0.1.0`; exit code 0

steps.expected: Non-zero exit and error includes unrecognized command
steps.observed: Error `No such command 'foobar'.` with exit code 2
Output suggested `profile`; exit code 2; no traceback observed

assertions.title: Data directory created on first use

steps.action: Delete isolated MLX_STACK_HOME and run `uv run mlx-stack profile`
steps.expected: Command succeeds and creates data directory
steps.observed: Before run directory was missing; profile command exited 0 and created `/tmp/mlx-stack-user-testing/foundation-setup-profile-core` with mode 755

assertions.title: Detects known Apple Silicon chip with correct specs

steps.action: Collect reference hardware values (`sysctl`, `system_profiler`) and run `uv run mlx-stack profile`
steps.expected: CLI reports matching chip, GPU cores, memory, and lookup-table bandwidth
steps.observed: CLI reported Apple M5 Max, 40 GPU cores, 128 GB memory, 546.0 GB/s bandwidth, matching system references and known table value

assertions.title: Unknown chip uses estimation with bench suggestion

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack profile` with isolated `/tmp` shims returning unknown chip `Apple M9 Ultra`
steps.expected: Bandwidth marked estimate, warning suggests `mlx-stack bench --save`, command exits 0 and writes profile
steps.observed: Output showed `Memory Bandwidth 400.0 GB/s (estimate)`, displayed calibration warning, wrote profile.json, exit code 0

steps.action: Run `uv run mlx-stack profile` with shimmed `sysctl` returning Intel brand string
steps.expected: Hard error message, non-zero exit, no profile file written
steps.observed: Output `mlx-stack requires Apple Silicon (M1 or later)`, exit code 1, and `profile_written=no`

assertions.title: Profile JSON is valid, complete, and correctly located

steps.action: Inspect and parse isolated `profile.json` after successful profile run
steps.expected: File exists at MLX_STACK_HOME/profile.json with required typed fields and valid profile_id
steps.observed: File existed and JSON validation confirmed required keys, correct types, non-null values, and profile_id pattern

summary: Tested 8 assigned assertions (VAL-SETUP-001..004, VAL-PROFILE-001..004): 8 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked.
